rules.statement: The first proviso to section 175 applies under the circumstances outlined in the ratio of the decision.
rules.supporting_quote: The first proviso to section 175 (1) of the Civil Procedure Code vests the discretion in the trial judge to permit the witness to be called ''if special circumstances appear to it to render such a course advisable in the interests of justice'. There was a total lack of 'special circumstances' postulated in the proviso to section 175 (1) of the Civil Procedure Code. The trial judge was right in refusing to exercise has discretion in favour of the defendant
